description: This file implements system notification handling for an Android app, including permission checks, notification channel management, and posting notifications based on JSON input.

classes.name: SystemNotifyRequest
classes.description: Data class representing the notification request with title, body, sound, and priority.

classes.name: SystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission check and posting notifications.

classes.name: AndroidSystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Implementation of SystemNotificationPoster for Android, managing notification channels and posting notifications.

classes.name: SystemHandler
classes.description: Main class handling system notifications, parsing JSON requests, authorization, and delegating post actions.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if notifications are authorized, including permission checks for API >= 33.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Posts a notification based on the provided SystemNotifyRequest.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Ensures the notification channel exists for the given priority and returns its ID.

methods.name: compatPriority
methods.description: Converts priority string to NotificationCompat priority value.

methods.name: isSilentSound
methods.description: Determines if the sound is silent based on input string.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON request, performing authorization and parsing, and attempts to post notification.

methods.name: parseNotifyRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a SystemNotifyRequest object, extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a JsonObject.
